name: owner-invoice
title: Training account
for_each: select id, number from invoices order by number

sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select number, owner, month, issued_on, due_on, dollars(subtotal_cents) as subtotal, dollars(gst_cents) as gst, dollars(total_cents) as total, dollars(owing_cents) as owing from v_invoices where id = $1

sections.title: Fees and charges by horse
sections.note: Each line is your share of the cost, by the percentage you held on the day.
sections.sql: select h.name as horse, l.description, l.percent as your_share, dollars(l.amount_cents) as amount, case when l.gst then 'yes' else 'no' end as gst from invoice_lines l join horses h on h.id = l.horse_id where l.invoice_id = $1 order by h.name, l.kind desc, l.description

name: treatment-record
title: Treatment record (AR 104)
for_each: select id, name from horses where exists (select 1 from treatments t where t.horse_id = horses.id) order by name

sections.title: Horse
sections.sql: select code, name, sex, age, status, premises_name as premises from v_horses where id = $1

sections.title: Medications and treatments, last 2 years
sections.note: AR 104(2): name, date and time, product, route, amount, duration, who gave and authorised it, and why. Recorded by midnight on the day.
sections.sql: select given_local as given, product, kind, route, amount, duration, given_by, authorised_by, reason, recorded_local as recorded, record_standing as record from v_treatments where horse_id = $1 and given_at > local_now() - interval '2 years' order by given_at

name: horse-report
title: Horse report for owners
for_each: select id, name from v_horses where status <> 'left' order by name

sections.title: Where things stand
sections.sql: select name, sex, age, status, premises_name as premises, since, next_race from v_horses where id = $1

sections.title: Owners
sections.sql: select o.name, s.percent from shares s join owners o on o.id = s.owner_id where s.horse_id = $1 and s.from_on <= local_today() and (s.to_on is null or s.to_on >= local_today()) order by s.percent desc

sections.title: Recent work
sections.sql: select on_date, kind, distance_m, time_text as time, note from trackwork where horse_id = $1 order by on_date desc limit 8

sections.title: Races
sections.sql: select race_date, venue, race_no as race, race_name, distance_m, status, finish, dollars(prizemoney_cents) as prizemoney from races where horse_id = $1 and status <> 'scratched' order by race_date desc
